### PDU41002 read-only command set over SSH
### firmware 1.3.4 / hardware 1.2 / captured 2026-08-24
### OpenSSH 10.0p2 -> 192.168.1.246:22, under pty.fork()
###
### Compare against serial_reads.txt: after stripping serial's command echo and
### the shared trailing prompt, every response below is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the
### serial capture. That is the evidence for one CLI engine over two links.
###
### The one difference: SSH does NOT echo the command. Responses begin with the
### line terminator that followed the submitted command.

### LOGIN BANNER (SSH only; serial shows no banner)
### Timing: password prompt at ~3.5s, accepted at ~12.1s, banner at ~13.5s.
### ~7.5s of that is the device authenticating. Timeouts must allow for it.
(admin@192.168.1.246) password:
